rules.completed: the item's work is on master — a merged PR from its branch or naming it, or its named deliverables verified in the tree — and its acceptance criteria are met

rules.open: real remaining work: the fixer mints its issue
rules.no-roadmap: a tracker or epic whose work is tracked elsewhere: exempt from G with the label, never closed by this ticket
rules.close: fixed, with the merge that fixed it cited; only after the quorum agrees
rules.item: real open work with no roadmap item: the fixer adds GH-<n>
